title: #122 Environment Effect
prompt: Some people say that people are defined by the place where they grew up, but some argue that the environment only has little effect. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Use a celebrity you know to support your opinion.

promptSegments.text: Some people say that people are defined by the place where they grew up, but some argue that the environment only has little effect.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Use a celebrity you know to support your opinion.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.en: The community and family a person lives with teach them many things in daily life, as demonstrated by famous actors who grew up in big cities and learned to talk to many different kinds of people.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
